LESSON: EQUATIONS OF A STRAIGHT LINE

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: ALGEBRA
Topic 2.2: Equations of a Straight Line
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 15

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Equations of a Straight Line, part of ALGEBRA in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we use gradients in our daily activities? 2. How to interpret the equation y = mx + c in different situations?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Equations of a Straight Line together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
17

● Digital literacy: The learner accesses learning materials using digital devices with assistive technology or other resources to

explore steepness or gradients of places.

● Learning to learn: The learner builds on their own learning experiences as they place the ladder at different points on the

ground while discussing and comparing steepness.

Values:
• Integrity: The learner enhances discipline as they observe gradient/steepness in staircases in buildings, bridges or ramps.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Safety and security: The learner promotes awareness as they climb up and down places such as the stairs or hills and relate to

gradients.

Link to other subjects:

● Integrated Science: The learner uses the ladder to make work easier by using different gradients.

● Pre-Technical studies: The learner relates the concepts of parallel and perpendicular lines to technical drawing.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Ladder, Digital devices with assistive technology such as screen readers, screen magnifiers and adapted keyboard, Print and

Braille Course Book.
